name: magi-disjoint-calibration-v1
prompts: A ceramic artist in a sunlit workshop slowly shapes a tall blue clay vase on a spinning pottery wheel, with shelves of handmade bowls behind her.
An overhead camera follows a small orange research boat moving between geometric sheets of sea ice while soft pink clouds drift over the polar horizon.
A clockwork mechanical beetle walks across a moss-covered stone bridge in a miniature garden, its brass legs reflecting warm afternoon light.
A wide tracking shot of dancers carrying translucent ribbons through a quiet railway station, the colored fabric curling in the air beneath the arched glass roof.
